title: FloodGuard Companion Policy Discount — Rate Manual Rule
content:
Rate manual rule of the FloodGuard Private Flood Policy on the companion policy discount, the discount given at the tier's companion discount percentage.

## Clauses in force

1. One companion policy is enough, and the companion discount never stacks: holding more than one companion policy does not add a second discount.
2. A companion policy that ends midterm removes the discount only from the next renewal, never midterm.
3. The discount applies to the premium before the policy fee and before the renewal rate cap. The policy fee is never reduced by it.

## Retired clause — no longer in force

The former clause that granted the tier's companion discount percentage whenever the same property address was insured under a live HomeGuard, CondoGuard, RentGuard or LandlordGuard policy of the same customer, judged across the customer's Larkspur portfolio at binding and on each renewal offer date (a live policy being one that is bound, in force, pending cancellation or pending nonrenewal), is **no longer in force**. It has been superseded by the current basis for the companion discount on the renewal offer date and is not applied.

## Points of judgement (hypothetical)

- **Two companion policies.** A hypothetical customer with a companion discount from one policy at the address gains nothing further from a second companion policy at that address; the discount is taken once.
- **Companion policy ending midterm.** A hypothetical companion policy that ends in the fourth month of the flood term leaves the flood term's discount in place for the rest of that term; the discount falls away from the next renewal.
- **Where it acts.** On a hypothetical premium of 800.00 USD with a policy fee of 50.00 USD and a discount of 5%, the discount is 40.00 USD, taken from the 800.00 USD premium; the 50.00 USD fee is charged in full.

superseded_clauses: companion_discount_pct applies when the same property address is insured under a live HomeGuard, CondoGuard, RentGuard or LandlordGuard policy of the same customer, judged across the customer's Larkspur portfolio at binding and on each renewal offer date; a live policy is one that is bound, in force, pending cancellation or pending nonrenewal.
